note: What the Supabase fleet is SUPPOSED to contain. check-supabase-build-currency.mjs used to report only the projects some management token handed it, so a project no token could see was not 'unreadable' — it was absent, and absent read as fine. This file is what turns that into a fact: every ref here must be read by some token on every run, or the run goes red naming the product. It also makes a dead token decidable — if all of these were read without it, the token cost us no coverage and is housekeeping rather than an hourly alarm.
sourceOfTruth: Captured from the Supabase Management API itself (the inventory the run prints under 'observed project inventory'), NOT from the projects' docs/Credentials.txt, where dead and superseded refs sit next to live ones. ReplyFlow staging has five candidate refs on disk and only one live one.
whereTheApiIsNotEnough: CORRECTED 2026-09-01. This file used to cite Beize Jass Tour as the proof that the API beats Credentials.txt — 'Credentials.txt says uyksotlmrlxhmyeopktl, the API says dkxdlovwzsxnepoteebk' — and it had the two backwards. The API inventory is only ever as complete as the set of management tokens this repo holds: it lists every project in an account we have a PAT for, and CANNOT list a project in an account we do not. dkxdlovwzsxnepoteebk is the OLD Jass-Tour project under api@predivo.ch, found EMPTY on 2026-08-22 (all tables PGRST205, edge function gone) and deliberately abandoned; the live database is uyksotlmrlxhmyeopktl under a NEW account 11api@predivo.ch, which no monitor token can see. So the API showed only the husk, and for ten days check-supabase-build-currency.mjs reported 'OK Beize Jass Tour current' and expire-stale-sessions.mjs reported 'SWEPT ... 0 stale sessions' about an empty database standing in for the real one. Proven by reading the deployed bundle: https://beize-jass-tour.mueller.ro/assets/index-XsB6xCrX.js contains uyksotlmrlxhmyeopktl.supabase.co, and jass-tour-ui-kit/docs/Credentials.txt says the same. RULE: the API inventory is the source of truth for projects inside accounts we hold a token for, and says NOTHING about the ones we do not — a live product's own deployed bundle outranks it.
managementApiField: "managementApi": false marks a project NO management token in this repo can reach, so the two PAT-driven sweeps (build currency, stale-session expiry) must not compare themselves against it — they would red every hour with a gap nobody on duty can close. They print it as OUT OF REACH and file it to the board instead. It does NOT excuse the project from watchdogs that reach it another way: check-supabase-machine-health.mjs talks to the project directly with JASSTOUR_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and still requires it. Clearing the flag needs a human to add a management token for the owning account (Beize Jass Tour: account 11api@predivo.ch — CLOSED 2026-09-02, its PAT is now the repo secret SUPABASE_TOKEN_JASSTOUR and the flag is gone; no project carries this flag today).
maintenance: A project INTENTIONALLY deleted must be removed from this list in the same change, or the check reds forever asking where it went. A project ADDED shows up in the run's observed inventory and should be added here — until it is, nothing guarantees anyone is watching it.
